newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Prairies to see rain in west, sun in east.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Prairies to see rain in west, sun in east.

text.p: Canada's Prairies on Tuesday were forecast to see rain in the west and sun in the east, Environment Canada said.
Alberta should see clouds with snow in the foothills and rain in the south with highs of 2 to 14 Celsius.
Saskatchewan should see rain in the west with highs of 10 to 15 Celsius.
Manitoba should see a mix of sun and cloud with highs of 8 to 11 Celsius.
